name: League of Super Evil: Card Game of Doom
summary: Free-to-play digital collectible card game based on the League of Super Evil TV series. Originally hosted on leagueofsuperevil.com, where it was available between 2011 to 2016 according to archived Wayback Machine snapshots. Gameplay featured simple head-to-head card battles reminiscent of titles such as Animation Throwdown: The Quest for Cards.
